node.title: Provenance & Audit Trail — ticket to shipped change
node.summary: Audit trails from ticket to shipped change for AI regulatory compliance.
node.interview_question: With the EU AI Act high-risk deadline now deferred to Dec 2027, how do you keep this from being a compliance feature looking for a deadline?

competitor.name: Datadog
competitor.positioning: Datadog (and SCM-native audit logs) already provide audit/observability trails enterprises trust; Faros must prove the AI-session-level provenance is uniquely needed.
